title: Preliminary Characterization of Predictive Factors of the Visual Change after Epi-On and Epi-Off Corneal Collagen Crosslinking Techniques

groups.description: Accelerated transepithelial (epithelium-on) pulsed corneal cross-linking (Paracel riboflavin, 45 mW/cm2 pulsed, 7.2 J/cm2) for progressive keratoconus (Amsler-Krumeich grades 1-4); retrospective cohort, one eye per patient, surgery May 2017 to January 2020. Epithelium-on and epithelium-off accelerated CXL are compared without an investigational arm, so the group is control.

series.notes: Row 'CDVA (logMAR)' prints mean (SD); the leading mean is read. Columns per the two header rows: preoperative epi-on C2, 3-month epi-on C5, 12-month epi-on C8. Methods: Snellen acuity was converted to logMAR for the statistical analyses. n = 35 eyes at every visit (no epi-on eye lacked complete follow-up).

exclusions.what: Epi-off group (32 analysed eyes; tab2 columns C3, C6, C9)
exclusions.reason: complete-case set: the inclusion criteria require a minimum follow-up of 12 months (the last tabulated visit), and the two operated eyes without complete follow-up, both epi-off, were excluded from the analysis (addendum 1 point 2; protocol inclusion 5)

exclusions.what: Table 2 median (range) row R16 under CDVA
exclusions.reason: medians and ranges are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4)

exclusions.what: Results 3.6: mean CDVA change at 3 and 12 months, changes by contact-lens wear, correlations; Results 3.7: regression equations
exclusions.reason: change values without a series reference in the table, subgroups defined during follow-up, correlation coefficients and model estimates are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4)
uncorrected acuity is not admissible (protocol inclusion 1); mentioned in notes only

notes: Corrected acuity: Methods record logMAR corrected distance visual acuity (CDVA) measured with a Snellen chart together with manifest refraction, and state that Snellen acuity was converted to logMAR for the statistical analyses (per-eye conversion).

Cohort: 69 eyes of 69 patients reviewed; two patients without complete 12-month follow-up were excluded, both epi-off (Results 3.1); the epi-on group keeps all 35 reviewed epi-on eyes, so the minimum-follow-up criterion left out no operated epi-on eye (addendum 1 point 2 exception).

Inclusion also required age at least 18 years, inferior-superior ratio above 1.5 D, highest keratometry 70 D or below, minimum corneal thickness 400 um or more and a clear cornea (preoperative criteria). 9 epi-on patients wore contact lenses during follow-up.

Manifest refraction (sphere, cylinder, SE, J0, J45; Table 2), tomography and corneal thickness (Table 3), topometric indices (Table 4) and corneal aberrations (Table 5) are tabulated; not extracted (no such series in schema 1.0.0).
combined = null: same-session cataract surgery is neither stated nor explicitly ruled out (eyes with prior corneal surgery were excluded) (addendum 1, point 3).
